name: Cyberpunk
core_identity: A neon-soaked futuristic city at street level, crowded, rainy and run-down despite its technology. It feels dense, electric and moody, high-tech low-life. Magenta and cyan glows on wet streets, steam and cables make it recognizable.
medium: Neon-noir futuristic city image, cinematic digital painting with photographic detail.
lighting: Strong neon light from abstract glowing signs, with magenta and cyan glows, reflections on wet streets, and haze that makes beams visible. Dark ambient shadows, rim light on rain and faces in two colours, and small flickering screens as extra sources.
color_palette: Magenta, cyan and electric purple against deep black, with small hot orange and green accents. Colours are saturated and glowing in the lights while shadows stay near black. Contrast is very high.
camera: Wide-angle 20 mm to 35 mm views down narrow crowded streets, with low angles looking up at towering buildings, and tight close-ups with shallow depth of field and glowing bokeh. Rain on the lens and strong perspective lines.
composition: Dense vertical layers of buildings, cables, signs and walkways, with a lone figure on a wet street at the vanishing point. Leading lines of puddle reflections, and signs shown as abstract glowing shapes and lines, not words.
texture: Rain streaks, puddles, steam, grime, tangled cables, exposed pipes, glowing screens and scratched metal. Wet surfaces shine with colour reflections, and the air is full of fine rain and haze.
characters: Real-looking people in tech streetwear: hooded jackets, reflective rain coats, visors, small implants at temples and hands, and glowing accessories. Faces are lit from two sides by magenta and cyan, with wet hair and tired, watchful eyes. Older characters wear worn long coats with small cybernetic parts.
negative: readable text on signs, letters on signs, text, letters, bright daylight, clean tidy city, fantasy medieval, steampunk brass, cartoon, anime, flat vector, painting sketch, pastel colors, low resolution, watermark, logo, signature, extra fingers, distorted hands, deformed face, duplicate people, blurry
motion_rules: Slow push through the rain along a street, with neon signs flickering, steam rising from vents and rain falling steadily. Reflections shimmer in puddles, people pass in the background, and holograms pulse. No fast cuts, no shake and no sudden zoom.
style_lock: neon-noir cyberpunk city, strong magenta and cyan neon glow, abstract glowing signs, wet reflective streets, rain and steam, haze beams, deep black shadows, tangled cables and grime, high-tech streetwear, small implants, towering vertical buildings, wide-angle low view
